title: "R Notebook Covariance Matrix"
output: html_notebook
---

This is the code provided in the assignment. 
```{r}
library(MASS)

gen_data<-function(n) {
  p<-15
  n1<-n2<-n/2
  cov_1<-diag(rep(1,p))+0.2
  x_class1<-mvrnorm(n1,mu=rep(3,p),Sigma= cov_1)
  x_class2<-mvrnorm(n2,mu=rep(2,p),Sigma= cov_1)
  x<-rbind(x_class1, x_class2)
  y<-rep(c(1,2),c(n1, n2))
  df<-as.data.frame(cbind(x,y))
  names(df)<-c(paste0("x",1:p),"y")
  return(df)
  }
```

This is the generation of data portion. 
```{r}
train_set_1_50_samples <- gen_data(50)
train_set_2_10000_samples <- gen_data(10000)
test_set_1_10000_samples <- gen_data(10000)

train_set_1_50_samples
train_set_2_10000_samples
test_set_1_10000_samples
```

Convert y output variable of 1/2 to 0/1 for logistic regression. Keep old column create new column
```{r}

train_set_1_50_samples$y_updated <- ifelse(train_set_1_50_samples$y ==2, 1, 0)
train_set_2_10000_samples$y_updated <- ifelse(train_set_2_10000_samples$y ==2, 1, 0)
test_set_1_10000_samples$y_updated <- ifelse(test_set_1_10000_samples$y == 2, 1, 0)
```

A logistic regression model and LDA model is trained using 50 samples

```{r}
logistic_regression_model <- glm(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15, data = train_set_1_50_samples, family=binomial)
linear_discriminant_model <- lda(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15, data = train_set_1_50_samples)
```

LDA and logistic regression is used to predict classifications of 10000 test samples
```{r}
lr_classifications <- predict(logistic_regression_model, test_set_1_10000_samples, type="response")
lr_classes <- ifelse(lr_classifications>0.5, 1, 0)
lda_classifications <- predict(linear_discriminant_model,test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes <- lda_classifications$class

```

The performance is measured by comparing lr and lda classes with actual labels.
```{r}
lr_performance = mean(lr_classes == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])
lda_performance = mean(lda_classes == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])
```

Accuracy is printed
```{r}
cat("LR performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lr_performance, "\n")
cat("LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lda_performance, "\n")
```

Linear discriminant and logistic regression are trained using 10000 samples and classes from test set are predicted accordingly. 
```{r}

logistic_regression_model_large <- glm(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15, data = train_set_2_10000_samples, family=binomial)
linear_discriminant_model_large <- lda(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)

lr_classifications_large <- predict(logistic_regression_model_large, test_set_1_10000_samples, type="response")
lr_classes_large <- ifelse(lr_classifications>0.5, 1, 0)
lda_classifications_large <- predict(linear_discriminant_model,test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes_large <- lda_classifications$class

lr_performance_large = mean(lr_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])
lda_performance_large = mean(lda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])

cat("LR performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lr_performance_large, "\n")
cat("LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lda_performance_large, "\n")
```

The average accuracy is calculated over 100 runs for the large train set. 
```{r}
lr_100_accuracies <- numeric(100)
lda_100_accuracies <- numeric(100)

for (i in 1:100) {
  
logistic_regression_model_large <- glm(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 + x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15, data = train_set_2_10000_samples, family=binomial)
  
linear_discriminant_model_large <- lda(y_updated ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)

lr_classifications_large <- predict(logistic_regression_model_large, test_set_1_10000_samples, type="response")
lr_classes_large <- ifelse(lr_classifications>0.5, 1, 0)
lda_classifications_large <- predict(linear_discriminant_model,test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes_large <- lda_classifications$class
  
lr_performance_large = mean(lr_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])
lda_performance_large = mean(lda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y_updated"]])
  
lr_100_accuracies[i] <- lr_performance_large
lda_100_accuracies[i] <- lda_performance_large
}

average_over_100_lr_accuracy <- mean(lr_100_accuracies)
average_over_100_lda_accuracy <- mean(lda_100_accuracies)

cat("Average LR performance in terms of accuracy on test set over 100 runs:", average_over_100_lr_accuracy, "\n")
cat("Average LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set over 100 runs:", average_over_100_lda_accuracy, "\n")

```
